list.onLoad

Creating the list instance triggers onLoad and onReady once in this example.

When should work happen?

Initialize once for this instance: onLoad handles initial parameters; onReady indicates the initial view is ready. Neither callback means a data request has completed.

Respond when the page reappears: onShow can run multiple times on the same instance. Refresh data that may have changed; onHide can pause work and onUnload can clean up resources.

Should every request run again on each appearance?

This example uses ordinary navigateTo and navigateBack. Other navigation and tab operations may differ. Do not reload every request on every onShow; decide which data may be stale and prevent duplicate work.
